question: What does registration revision 3 specify that the pilot never used?

specified.note: 13 coefficients incl. c0 + deltas + delta-deltas, librosa, 25 ms window / 10 ms hop. Features with no learned structure.

Run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under joint: best layer 9 on every span, balanced accuracy 0.616–0.625. Ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position (span grid §8).
Index 0 is the input to the first layer; 1–12 are layer outputs. Pretraining data not yet checked against the paper.

answer:
Of the items the registration specifies, only one never appears in the pilot: **facebook/wav2vec2-base**, registered as an exploratory representation [rep-wav2vec2]. The rows don't name the revision directly, so I'm assuming this "specified" list is revision 3. Every other item lists run-pilot among its uses. That covers the four conditions [cond-joint] [cond-random] [cond-speaker] [cond-word], the three pooling methods [pool-mean] [pool-max] [pool-midpoint], the word-lookup baseline and control task [ctrl-lookup] [task-control], the linear probe [probe-linear], the voicing and speaker-ID tasks [task-voicing] [task-speaker], the [ɾ] environment [env-flap], and the MFCC and WavJEPA representations [rep-mfcc] [rep-wavjepa].

wav2vec2-base was used later, though, in run-rep-communities and run-span-grid [rep-wav2vec2]. In the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29, 10,334 sites under the joint condition), layer 9 was best on every span. Balanced accuracy was 0.616–0.625, ahead of MFCC on every span (C5) [rep-wav2vec2]. A recorded caveat is that its index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position information [rep-wav2vec2].

The pilot therefore covered everything registered except this exploratory model, and that gap was filled in subsequent runs.
